description: This file contains SQL code for creating and configuring a 'projects' table in a database, including schema definition, extensions, and policy setup for row-level security in a Supabase environment.
calls: create extension if not exists pgcrypto
alter table public.projects enable row level security
drop policy if exists "Allow select for all (dev)" on public.projects
drop policy if exists "Allow insert for all (dev)" on public.projects
create policy "Allow select for all (dev)" on public.projects for select using (true)
create policy "Allow insert for all (dev)" on public.projects for insert with check (true)
